_note: Curated article topics for scripts/refill_tickets.py (daily-tickets.md refill). A topic is a BRIEF, not copy: the writer sources every claim (PubMed/DOI/official pages, live PDP) or cuts it. Rules for adding a topic: (1) product = a handle in `products` below (AgeAura = ageaura-pure-nmn-tmg-nad-complex only); (2) primary keyword AND title must contain one of topic_fitness.py SEGMENT_MODIFIERS (for beginners / for seniors / for athletes / for runners / for fertility / over 40|50|60 / side effects / dosage / how to take / how much / how long / vs / morning or night / before bed / empty stomach / with food / where to buy / buy / price / cost) — otherwise the strict gate FAILs [covered] once the brand has any article; (3) `segment` = a key of `segments` that no live title in the same family covers; (4) title <= 60 chars after {year}; (5) `link` = live /blogs/news handles to link instead of restating; (6) no Urolithin, peptides, MuscleMax, COA-led claims. Then: python3 scripts/refill_tickets.py --self-test && python3 scripts/refill_tickets.py --count 8 --dry-run. priority 1 runs first; reserve topics wait for the next refill.
